evals.fixture_requirements: Provide an accessible 90-minute English YouTube interview URL.
evals.prompt: 把这个 90 分钟英文 YouTube 访谈整理为精简版中文 Markdown，保留关键观点的时间戳。
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded Chinese summary with metadata and timestamp links.
assertions: Retrieves metadata and the best available transcript

evals.fixture_requirements: Provide an accessible YouTube URL with generated subtitles or downloadable audio.
evals.prompt: 这个视频没有人工字幕，请生成完整版中文对话稿。
evals.expected_output: A faithful dialogue note produced through documented fallback behavior.
assertions: Tries generated subtitles before audio transcription
Reports when Whisper fallback is used
Does not claim speaker identities without evidence

evals.prompt: 总结这个已经失效的 YouTube 链接：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=invalid。无法获取时请如实说明。
evals.expected_output: A concise, actionable failure report without fabricated content.
assertions: Reports that the source cannot be accessed
Suggests supplying a transcript or accessible file
